title: Battle rounds, movement and targeting

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 2098114 (0x002003c2), HLP file offset 528823 (0x000811b7), topic 334 'The Guts of Combat'
TOPICPOS 2166117 (0x00210d65), HLP file offset 547674 (0x00085b5a), topic 339 'Movement, Initiative and Firing in Battle'

setup.baseline: A controlled battle with identical ships on both sides.
setup.variable: One battle-plan setting, range or engine.

procedure: Record the battle VCR and round-by-round movement/firing.
Vary one battle-plan target/tactic at a time.
Repeat with starbases and multiple token weights.

documented: Battles last up to 16 rounds; each round is each token moving and firing in phases (documented-only).
Movement is 1-8 squares per round, in three phases by allowable movement; tokens move heaviest to lightest within +/-15% (documented-only).
Targeting tries the primary target type, then secondary, then disengages (documented-only).

unresolved: The movement formula is documented but its integer/rounding behavior is strings-only and unverified.
Initiative, damage and weapon stats are not fully recovered.
